title: Clef is available on Ollama's cloud
summary: Clef, a 27B multimodal decision model from Cloudflare, is now available on Ollama. Run it locally or on Ollama's cloud.
body_markdown:
Clef, a 27B multimodal decision model from Cloudflare,[is now available on Ollama](https://ollama.com/library/clef) . Users can run it locally or on Ollama’s cloud. Clef turns a state and a schema of typed questions into decisions. It supports text and image input and is compatible with the Jev and System One APIs.


Clef is fine-tuned from Qwen3.8-27B and released under the Apache 2.0 license.


### Highlights


- **Multimodal:** Make decisions over text, JSON, or images, including screenshots, receipts, forms, and photos.
- **One pass:** Clef reads the input once and scores every answer to every question at the same time, instead of writing a response word by word.
- **Leading accuracy:** Clef tops Cloudflare’s Decision Index and beats Jev on most of its benchmark suite.


### What you can build


Clef supports the following use cases:


- **Route a request:** Define destinations and when each applies. Clef returns the chosen destination and each destination’s probability.
- **Check a condition:** Define a yes-or-no question and the evidence. Clef returns true or false and the probability of each.
- **Apply a policy:** Define rules and allowed outcomes to receive a typed decision based on supplied text or images.
- **Read a document:** Supply a photo of a page and the fields to evaluate for field-by-field decisions with probabilities.
- **Tool-call moderation:** Check an agent’s tool call before it runs.

On Typesafe’s own workflow evals, Clef beats Jev in 3 of 4 areas:


Workflow Clef Clef-flash Jev


Invoice processing **64.7** 57.1 61.8


Customer service 76.3 **77.0** 76.0


Security incidents **62.9** 61.7 61.7


Agent trace observability 68.5 69.8 **71.6**
